checks.title: Tests pass, ruff clean, mypy clean
checks.measured: pytest exit 0, ruff exit 0, mypy exit 0
checks.threshold: pytest exit 0, ruff exit 0, mypy exit 0

checks.title: Zero duplicates, no nulls, exact amount round-trip
checks.measured: 2,389,053 rows; duplicates 0; nulls 0; round-trip failures 0; non-integer amounts 0
checks.threshold: duplicates <= 0; no nulls; raw->normalized->raw exact for every row

checks.title: Agreement with a second source on several random windows
checks.threshold: 3 windows on different days; count and amount within 2%

checks.title: Coverage lists every token and mechanism, and the headline states the gap
checks.threshold: coverage lists supported and unsupported; headline states unsupported share

checks.title: Rebuilding the derived tables twice produces identical scores
checks.threshold: both rebuilds exit 0 and produce the same scores hash

checks.title: Ingestion rolls back and recovers from a reorg without duplicating
checks.threshold: the reorg test exists and passes

checks.title: The classifier finds planted patterns without flagging synthetic genuine ones
Sensitivity analysis exists, and instability is stated in the headline if large
checks.threshold: analysis present; instability stated in the headline if shift > 15.0pp

checks.title: A random sample of the report's numbers reproduces
checks.threshold: 10 sampled commands reproduce their stated value exactly

checks.title: Language audit passes on generated reports
checks.threshold: no banned term used as an assertion in reports/ or public strings

checks.title: Below-minimum evidence renders as insufficient_evidence, never as zero
checks.threshold: a passing test proves the literal string is returned and no zero is

checks.title: Independent reviewer ran with no unresolved findings
checks.threshold: the newest reports/review_A*.md declares 0 unresolved findings
notes: unresolved findings count as FAIL (prompt rule 3.4.7)

checks.title: Blinded adjudication agrees, and the adjudication itself can fail
checks.measured: 28 flagged in sample; agreement 61.5% / 61.5%; inter-rater 0.0%; negative control 4.6%; abstention 26.2%; 0 advertised services flagged
checks.threshold: >= 10 flagged in sample; agreement >= 70% both adjudicators; inter-rater >= 70%; negative control <= 40%; no advertised service flagged; abstention <= 30%
